name: Frozen Cows detector paired0/90degree validation control v1
scope: Paired development sensitivity test on the same previously used validation images. Not a new independent test or proof of video failure cause.
pixel_transformation: np.rot90(native_cv2_BGR,k=-1).copy(); no interpolation/re-encoding/crop; original source bytes retained
box_transformation: continuous image edges: [x1,y1,x2,y2] -> [H-y2,x1,H-y1,x2] with output dimensions(H,W)

metrics.matching: one-to-one maximum-cardinality then maximum-IoU assignment, independent of prediction score after confidence filtering
metrics.primary: matched cow body recall and precision at confidence0.2/IoU0.5; all6conditions reported
metrics.paired_uncertainty: resample complete source dates10000times with RNG26; only6date clusters, exploratory bounds
metrics.not_reported: No native_video passage accuracy, independent-farm claim or PYNQ performance

sample_visuals.selection: first8 validation basenames ranked by SHA256(orientation-control-v1:+basename), fixed before predictions
